title: Prospective Opening-to-Middlegame TT-Sensitivity Cartography, Root-Move Instability Hotspot Mapping, Phase-Matched Cross-Engine Counterfactual Replication & Developer Regression Diagnostics

program_identity.primary_question: Across fresh phase-matched chess lines, where does exact TT semantic-use intervention reproducibly destabilize the chosen root move?
program_identity.terminal_product: Replayable developer regression cases linking phase, TT semantic-use event, engine, root-move change and legal PV contrast.

harvest_bridge.translation: P9 separately reports phase, source, engine and TT-semantic breadth; no single axis substitutes for another.

source_snapshot.freshness_rule: Exclude every recoverable P1-P8 candidate FEN hash before line admission.
source_snapshot.source_feasibility_repair: Official-stockfish opening-book PGNs were target-blindly rejected before P9 precommit because sampled sources did not provide the frozen EARLY_MIDDLEGAME window. Lichess July 2026 was then excluded before decompression because a runner checksum did not match the official published checksum; April/May/June full-game broadcasts are checksum-pinned instead. Phase windows and all causal gates remained unchanged.

phase_matching.position_choice: Within each admitted PGN line and phase window, select the legal canonical position with minimum SHA-256(FEN); the same line must supply all four phases.

primary_estimands.world_sensitive: At least one fired sampled exact-event intervention changes the baseline root move in an engine×position world.
primary_estimands.world_sensitivity_rate: ROOT_CHANGE fired events / fired sampled events in each engine×position world.
primary_estimands.phase_sensitive_world_fraction: Sensitive worlds / eligible worlds in a phase.
primary_estimands.phase_event_sensitivity_rate: ROOT_CHANGE fired events / fired sampled events in a phase.
primary_estimands.cross_engine_replication: For the same trajectory×phase position, at least two of three engines contain a ROOT_CHANGE event.
primary_estimands.semantic_class_map: ROOT_CHANGE counts and rates by TT semantic class within phase.

hotspot_rule.multiple_comparison_policy: No best-phase ranking and no post-hoc thresholding. Report every phase that meets the same prospectively frozen absolute replication rule, and every phase that does not.

regression_suite.positive_case: Exact addressed event with fired target and ROOT_CHANGE=true.
regression_suite.matched_control: Same engine×position and semantic class when an available fired event has ROOT_CHANGE=false; otherwise same trajectory×phase and engine with the same semantic class.
regression_suite.developer_use: Replayable regression witness bank; no Elo or strength claim.

implementation_roles.C_or_Cpp: Existing exact TT semantic-use intervention inside engine search.
implementation_roles.Python: PGN longitudinal phase matching, UCI orchestration, cartography and chess/PV phenotype.
implementation_roles.Rust: Deterministic aggregation, hotspot rule and regression manifest compiler.

stop_rule: If phase-matched corpus cannot be constructed prospectively, P9 closes CORPUS_HOLD.
If causal support gate fails, P9 closes SUPPORT_HOLD and no hotspot claim is issued.
If support passes, apply the same frozen hotspot rule to all four phases; do not rank or tune thresholds.
P9 closes after cartography and regression-suite materialization; it does not grow a new representation family.
claim_ceiling: P9 maps sensitivity under the exact declared engines, node budget, sampler and phase-matched PGN worlds; it is not a universal opening law.
P8 source-specific outcomes receive zero P9 confirmatory vote.
A hotspot is an operational regression hotspot, not a population prevalence or causal essence of a chess phase.
Cross-engine replication does not imply human strategic relevance.
P9 does not measure Elo, playing strength or best-move correctness.
